sessionStructure.intro: At PeaceFlow, we understand that seeking mental health support requires a safe, private, and empathetic space. Our team of 10+ certified psychologists is always ready to listen and walk alongside you.
sessionStructure.title: 🕐 A standard consultation session structure (30–60 min)
sessionStructure.subtitle: Each consultation typically lasts 45 to 60 minutes, carefully designed across 4 parts to ensure maximum effectiveness:
sessionStructure.step1Desc: The expert spends the first part getting to know you, building trust, and getting an overview of your history. The goal is to create a safe conversational space so you feel completely comfortable opening up.
sessionStructure.step2Desc: The expert asks open-ended questions to explore in depth why you're seeking support, your current worries, or recent events affecting your mind and behavior.
sessionStructure.step3Desc: Through clinical interviewing and detailed observation, the expert applies standardized medical tests such as DASS-21, GAD-7, PHQ-9, or PSQI. This systematic assessment helps accurately measure symptom severity.
sessionStructure.step4Desc: The expert summarizes the findings and discusses with you to agree on treatment goals. From there, a personalized intervention plan is created to help you overcome your difficulties step by step.
